coverage.references: All 14 inherited references preserved and two primary society/guideline sources added; de Alba MRI source no longer presented as surgical contraindication evidence; ACOG full text remains inaccessible.
coverage.currency: Current AWMF 2026 S3 v6.0 §6.6/6.E54 verified; 2016 predecessor not represented as current. AUGS terminology erratum checked for scope.
